### Bible Pathways 08/25/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-08-or-25-or-2002-1147210.html
Passage: Jeremiah 37:9-10
Points:
- King Zedekiah refused to repent and turned instead to an alliance with Egypt for protection.
- The Babylonians' temporary withdrawal created a false sense of security and self-deception among Judah's leadership.
- Jeremiah cautioned that human schemes and political maneuvers cannot overturn God's spoken word.
- Relying on personal wisdom and selectively following Scripture leads to spiritual blindness and destruction.
